case.description: A live rolling poll without an author panel whose only tier is Tier 0 (groups 1 and 2); seat 4 sends nothing, so seats 1 to 3 are registered. On the board path: the transcript, five admitted ballots (a member who joined during the poll at step N0, an opening member at N0 − 1, group 2's member at N0, the opening member's re-vote at N0 + 1, a member added during the poll at the step whose boundary is closes_at), a step before registration, a proof against another step's root, the first ballot relabelled to N0 + 1, and a byte-identical repeat of the first ballot.
